Description.SourceString: I commandeer this journal to send a message to you, adventurer! I don't think the penguins have found the game journals yet, so the line of communication is secure. I will say this only once: you must bring the Penguin Coins to me. It is imperative that the penguins do not get hold of this coin, or even become aware that they exist. If they do, then the whole operation, and perhaps the world, is compromised. We have the upper hand SOLELY because they are unaware of our operation. If the upper hand becomes an upper flipper, well, Guthix help us all.
